facts.fact: Al-Watwan reports Semlex has produced Comoros' biometric national identity cards and passports since 2007, and that enrolment for new cards was suspended from 2 March 2026 for the transition to GenKey, expected to resume on 27 March.

facts.fact: Biometric Update reports Comoros selected GenKey to produce biometric passports and national ID cards, replacing Semlex, which produced biometric IDs from 2007; issuance suspended until 26 March 2026 during the change.

Al-Watwan reports the Interior Ministry suspended production of biometric documents, including national cards, from 2 and 6 March to 26 March 2026 for a change of production provider, Semlex (17 years) to GenKey.

facts.fact: Comoros issues biometric national ID cards, produced in Moroni, with printing to start on Ndzuani and Genkey replacing Semlex as producer from April 2026.
Biometric identity cards and passports have been implemented in Comoros since 2008 and are still produced by Semlex, per the Interior Minister.

facts.fact: On 25 March 2026 Comoros authorities validated preparatory studies in Moroni for digitising the civil registry, introducing a unique Personal Identification Number as the cornerstone of citizen identity, under the Amecc programme funded by the French Embassy with UNICEF support.
